condition_descriptions.full: all modalities available; generation is conditioned on ranked Top-1 music
condition_descriptions.wo_video: video feature is zeroed; generation is conditioned on ranked Top-1 music
condition_descriptions.wo_audio_feature_only: Top-1 music feature is zeroed, but Top-1 title/artist metadata is kept
condition_descriptions.wo_audio_all: Top-1 music feature is zeroed and Top-1 title/artist metadata injection is disabled
condition_descriptions.wo_prompt: text prompt feature and user text are removed; Top-1 title/artist metadata is kept
condition_descriptions.wo_ltp: long-term preference feature is zeroed; Top-1 title/artist metadata is kept
